manual_reviews.title: [serve] MetricsPusher task dies with uncaught KeyError if stop_tasks() lands while an async task func is suspended
manual_reviews.reason: A released Ray 2.59.0 component check covers 24 conditions and 48 task outcomes across two processes. Both native asyncio creation stacks and coroutine origins recover all 8 tracked failing registration sites. No additional CoroPerf attribution is established. The report describes a latent pairing, not a currently reachable in-tree Serve path.
manual_reviews.reason_zh: Ray 2.59.0 组件对照在两个进程中核对 24 个条件、48 个任务结果；原生 asyncio 创建栈与 coroutine origin 均恢复 8 个启用跟踪的失败任务入口。未建立 coroPerf 额外补充的归属信息。上游描述的是潜在组合，现有 in-tree Serve 路径尚不触发。

manual_reviews.title: [Data] Parquet V2 starts one scan thread per fragment when packing small files
manual_reviews.reason: The report already records one scan thread per packed fragment, native thread counts, a cap comparison and retry correctness. No missing originating caller or task identity is established. No local Parquet workload, proposed patch or benchmark was executed for this review.
manual_reviews.reason_zh: 报告已记录每个打包 fragment 启动一个扫描线程、线程数、限流对照与重试正确性；未建立发起调用者或任务身份缺失问题。本次审阅未执行 Parquet 工作负载、候选补丁或基准。

manual_reviews.title: [Bug]: --otlp-traces-endpoint sends no spans when another integration owns the global tracer provider
manual_reviews.reason: The report identifies the discarded tracer return, the global-provider lookup and the warning that rejects replacing a provider. It establishes exporter routing through the global registry, not a demonstrated missing coroutine caller. No vLLM or OpenTelemetry program was executed locally.
manual_reviews.reason_zh: 报告已定位被丢弃的 tracer 返回值、全局 provider 查询及拒绝替换 provider 的日志；问题是全局注册表决定导出管线，未证明存在协程调用者缺失。未执行 vLLM 或 OpenTelemetry 程序。

manual_reviews.title: [BUG]: Cannot drop a runtime in a context where blocking is not allowed.
manual_reviews.reason: The body reports pyo3_runtime.PanicException and frontend termination although the title omits panic wording. Persistently skipped by the explicit body-error signature rule. No frontend, container or panic trigger was executed; safety impact is unassessed.
manual_reviews.reason_zh: 正文报告 pyo3_runtime.PanicException 及前端退出，标题未含 panic。已按明确正文错误签名持久暂缓；未执行前端、容器或异常触发，安全影响未评估。

manual_reviews.title: bug(discovery): dropping list_and_watch stream leaves backend watcher running
manual_reviews.reason: The source-level report describes abandoned discovery streams retaining producer tasks and backend watch resources. Repeated resource retention warrants a persistent reproduction hold. No Kubernetes, KV backend or accumulation workload was executed; safety impact is unassessed.
manual_reviews.reason_zh: 源码分析报告描述丢弃 discovery stream 后生产任务与后端 watch 资源仍保留；重复积累资源的线索列入持久暂缓。未执行 Kubernetes、KV 后端或积累负载，安全影响未评估。

manual_reviews.title: incorrect handling of failed check connections
manual_reviews.reason: The report describes failed-check connections returning to the pool in an invalid transaction state and exhausting the pool. Persistently held as an availability/resource-exhaustion lead. No database workload, failure trigger or repair test was executed; safety impact is unassessed.
manual_reviews.reason_zh: 报告描述检查失败的连接以异常事务状态回到池中，导致连接池耗尽；按可用性与资源耗尽线索持久暂缓。未执行数据库负载、失败触发或修复测试，安全影响未评估。

manual_reviews.title: [Bug] Diffusion orchestrator: deeply nested result frame escapes per-request handler and stops routing loop
manual_reviews.reason: The report describes malformed nested result metadata escaping per-request recovery and terminating the diffusion routing loop. Persistently held as an input-driven availability lead. No payload, Docker image, socket probe or GPU run was executed; safety impact is unassessed.
manual_reviews.reason_zh: 报告描述畸形嵌套结果元数据逃逸请求级错误处理并终止 diffusion 路由循环；按输入触发的可用性线索持久暂缓。未执行载荷、Docker 镜像、socket 探针或 GPU 运行，安全影响未评估。
